description: Shapes that several sh.unset records share.

image.description: A picture in the member's own repository, held as Bluesky's post image holds one (app.bsky.embed.images#image). Each use embeds it and adds its own caption and fit (ADR 0070).
JPEG with no metadata, its longest side at most 2560 px.

alt.description: Text for people who cannot see the picture. May be empty.

aspectRatio.description: The picture's width to height, as in app.bsky.embed.defs#aspectRatio, so a reader can hold its space before it loads.
